scope: Synthetic fixed-target linear write kernels and a toy acquisition loop, not pretrained LLM editing.
arithmetic: float64 work and journal arrays; each live weight write rounded to the storage precision; bf16 emulated.
access_policy: Restoration functions receive only declared metadata. Forward generators make targets/journals from pre-edit states; full originals are used for evaluator scores and the explicit checkpoint baseline.
storage_policy: Numeric payload bytes only; metadata includes all arrays required by that method. Python overhead excluded.
svd_policy: Drop top 1 singular component, preselected without reference-based hyperparameter tuning.

scope.model: synthetic linear categorical classifier; not a pretrained LLM
scope.acquisition: expected unlabelled-probe entropy reduction under starting-model class probabilities
scope.claim: confidence-based acquisition proxy; no guaranteed causal or accuracy gain
scope.oracle: synthetic teacher supplies one real label only after each selected query
scope.reference_use: evaluator drift measurements and explicit checkpoint baseline only
scope.memory_measurement: evaluator retains reference/per-trial copies; protocol payload counts are not measured process peak memory
scope.query_baseline_comparison: random/uncertainty share label budget and retained edit rule; compute is not matched
scope.bottom_rank_selection: fixed drop_rank=1; not tuned against original weights or heldout labels
scope.precision: initial and updated weights use requested precision; scoring uses float64 arithmetic
scope.candidate_order: forward/reverse evaluation of the same available candidates; class order fixed
